name: Conference talk video edit in DaVinci Resolve

mentions.name: Conference talk video edit in DaVinci Resolve
mentions.description: An edited full video of the "Human Creativity in the Age of AI" conference talk, produced in DaVinci Resolve with a jump start from Codex, along with short clips cut from the talk, including one featuring the guitar solo generator.
mentions.source_excerpt: In the 2-3 weeks after the talk I spent a ton of time editing and laying out a really nice video of it, which I am also quite proud of.
